description: Flametongue Weapon Level 60 155 Mana Instant Requires Shaman Requires level 56 Requires Melee Weapon Imbue the Shaman's weapon with fire. Each hit causes ( 3122 / 77 - 1 + 0) to ( 3122 / 25 + 0) additional Fire damage, based on the speed of the weapon. Slower weapons cause more fire damage per swing. When applied to main hand, disables any benefit you personally receive from Flametongue Totem. Lasts for 60 minutes.
name: Flametongue Weapon
